audit_events_actor_matches_source.name: audit_events_actor_matches_source
audit_events_actor_matches_source.value:
("hris"."audit_events"."source" = 'USER' and "hris"."audit_events"."actor_account_id" is not null and "hris"."audit_events"."job_name" is null)
      or ("hris"."audit_events"."source" = 'JOB' and "hris"."audit_events"."job_name" is not null)

employment_events_notice_only_resigned.name: employment_events_notice_only_resigned
employment_events_notice_only_resigned.value: ("hris"."employment_events"."resignation_notice" is not null) = ("hris"."employment_events"."reason_kind" is not distinct from 'RESIGNED')

field_permits_revoke_complete.name: field_permits_revoke_complete
field_permits_revoke_complete.value: ("hris"."field_permits"."revoked_at" is null) = ("hris"."field_permits"."revoke_reason" is null) and ("hris"."field_permits"."revoked_at" is null) = ("hris"."field_permits"."revoked_by_account_id" is null)

training_reviews_shape.name: training_reviews_shape
training_reviews_shape.value:
case "hris"."training_reviews"."decision"
      when 'APPROVE' then "hris"."training_reviews"."promotion_effective_on" is not null and "hris"."training_reviews"."placement_id" is not null and "hris"."training_reviews"."review_again_on" is null
      else "hris"."training_reviews"."review_again_on" is not null and "hris"."training_reviews"."reason" is not null and btrim("hris"."training_reviews"."reason") <> '' and "hris"."training_reviews"."placement_id" is null end

setting_values_cancel_complete.name: setting_values_cancel_complete
setting_values_cancel_complete.value:
("hris"."setting_values"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("hris"."setting_values"."cancelled_at" is not null)
      and ("hris"."setting_values"."cancelled_at" is null or ("hris"."setting_values"."cancelled_by_account_id" is not null and btrim(coalesce("hris"."setting_values"."cancel_reason", '')) <> ''))

attendance_corrections_state.name: attendance_corrections_state
attendance_corrections_state.value: ("hris"."attendance_corrections"."in_at" is null) = ("hris"."attendance_corrections"."branch_id" is null) and ("hris"."attendance_corrections"."out_at" is null or "hris"."attendance_corrections"."in_at" is not null)

attendance_records_proof.name: attendance_records_proof
attendance_records_proof.value: "hris"."attendance_records"."kind" = 'BREAK' or ("hris"."attendance_records"."latitude" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."longitude" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."distance_m" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."photo_file_id" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."attempt_id" is not null)

work_shift_versions_break_complete.name: work_shift_versions_break_complete
work_shift_versions_break_complete.value:
("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_minutes" is null) = ("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_start_from" is null)
      and ("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_minutes" is null) = ("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_start_until" is null)
